description: Esther has consistently demonstrated a commitment to advocating for policies that promote family values. Esther has supported the “Protect the Tennessee Minors Act,” which mandates age-verification processes to prevent minors from accessing harmful online adult content. As a pro-life advocate, she sponsored legislation aimed at protecting both the unborn and the life of the mother. […]
